notes:
Cloud files now have a tick box each for iCloud, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and MEGA.
Ticking a service also points the folder at it, so you can scan it straight away.
A service you have not installed is greyed out and says so, instead of finding nothing.
The Cleaner can clear the cache each cloud app leaves behind, often several gigabytes. Your synced files are never touched.
The size filter is simpler: skip small files, or look at everything.
